headline: Learn the craft with confidence, technique, and professional direction.
intro: Time 4U is building a modern massage therapy training experience for students who want a strong foundation in both technical skill and patient care.
cardBody: Our school blends hands-on learning with a professional clinic mindset so students gain real-world experience in a calm, respectful environment.
interestBody: Interested in becoming a massage therapist? Sign up to get updates on enrollment, start dates, and how to apply — or call or text anytime.
studentIntro: Practice massages are available now at reduced pricing while the school program grows.
